products.title: White Chicken Chili
products.body_html:
White Chicken Chili: Fuel your adventure with Peak Refuel’s White Chicken Chili, packed with 41 grams of protein and 760 calories to keep you energized.

Preparation Instructions:

1. Open pouch at tear mark. Remove oxygen absorber.

2. Carefully add 1 cup (8 oz) boiling water to pouch.

3. Stir well and zip pouch closed. Let stand for 10 minutes.

4. Open pouch, stir again and enjoy!

  • Protein – 41g per pouch
  • Servings - 2
  • Serving size – ½ pouch
  • Contains – Milk, Wheat
  • Net Weight – 4.94 oz
  • Made & Packaged in the USA
  • Calories per Pouch - 760
  • Prep Time - 10 min
